description: Returns the newest received email that matches, waiting up to `timeout` seconds (0 to 50, default 30) for one to arrive: after asking a service for a sign-up code, a magic link or a password reset, name the sender with `from` (an address, or a domain and its subdomains) and `has: code` or `has: link`. The email carries `codes` (each a `value`) and `links` (each a `url` and a `kind`: verify, sign_in, reset_password, unsubscribe, other). Mail judged forged and quarantined mail never match. `message` is null and `timed_out` true when none arrived in time.

agent_id.description: Filter by agent id or name. A key tied to one agent always reads that agent's mail, and naming another agent is a 403.

from.description: Only mail from this sender: an address (`noreply@github.com`, in any case) or a domain (`github.com`, which takes its subdomains such as `mail.github.com` and never `github.com.evil.example`). It is the From header's address, proven only when the message's `dmarc` is `pass`. Anything else answers `400 invalid_param_value`.

has.description: `code`: only a message with at least one entry in `codes`. `link`: only one with a `verify`, `sign_in` or `reset_password` link. Absent: any message that matches the other filters.

since.description: Only mail received at or after this time: an ISO 8601 time such as `2026-10-05T07:00:00Z`, or a date (midnight UTC). Any other value answers `400 invalid_param_value`. Default: the last 5 minutes. Pass the time you asked the service to send, so an older code never answers.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a match, 0 to 50 (default 30). 0 looks once and answers at once.

to.description: Only mail sent to this address, in any case: the message's `delivered_to`. In a query string, write its `+` as `%2B`: one left as it is arrives as a space, which is read back as `+`. Mail received before 2026-10-16 has no `delivered_to` and never matches. Anything that is not an address answers `400 invalid_param_value`.

name: mails_wait_for_email
title: Wait for an email
